categories.main_business_segments: Satellite Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical industry focusing on the research, production, and sales of polypropylene, acrylic acid and esters, ethylene glycol, ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, and polyethylene. The company also develops functional chemicals, polymer new materials, and new energy materials, serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, healthcare, nutrition, sports, construction, and environmental governance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced and continuously optimized production technologies including proprietary and patented processes for HDPE, AA/AE, EO, EG, and SAP. It emphasizes green and low-carbon production methods, such as propane dehydrogenation and esterification for acrylic acid and esters, and has developed a global supply chain for light hydrocarbons. Innovations include high-efficiency catalytic hydration for ethylene oxide and energy-saving process improvements, alongside digital transformation with AI and 5G-enabled smart manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Satellite Chemical serves a broad range of customers across multiple sectors including aerospace, automotive, electronics and semiconductors, medical and health care, nutrition and personal care, sports, construction, and environmental management. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with exports reaching over 160 countries and regions, establishing a global brand presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key production bases in Jiaxing, Pinghu, and Lianyungang. It also has subsidiaries and operations in the United States, Singapore, and Hong Kong, supporting its global market expansion. Domestic sales constitute the majority of revenue, but overseas sales have grown significantly, accounting for over 12% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Satellite Chemical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical supply chain, producing key chemical intermediates and high-end chemical new materials. It integrates upstream light hydrocarbon raw material processing with downstream functional chemicals and polymer materials manufacturing, forming a vertically integrated and comprehensive chemical industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on breakthroughs in high-performance catalysts, new energy materials, polymer new materials, and functional chemicals. It has established a future R&D center and collaborates with top universities to build a full-chain innovation system. Digital transformation, AI applications, and green low-carbon development are strategic pillars, with a planned R&D investment of 10 billion RMB over recent years.
categories.revenue_model: Satellite Chemical generates revenue primarily through product sales of chemical intermediates, functional chemicals, polymer new materials, and new energy materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with a mix of domestic and international customers. The company also engages in derivative financial instruments for hedging commodity price risks but does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the light hydrocarbon chemical industry with a strong market position in acrylic acid, ethylene glycol, and polymer materials. It faces competition from both domestic and international chemical manufacturers, especially in high-end polymer materials where import dependence remains high. Satellite Chemical leverages its integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and green manufacturing to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Satellite Chemical reported total assets of approximately 68.3 billion RMB, with operating revenue of 45.65 billion RMB, marking a 10% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached 6.07 billion RMB, a 26.8% increase from the previous year. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, demonstrating a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Satellite Chemical emphasizes high-quality, innovative chemical new materials with proprietary technologies and green production processes. Its integrated supply chain and product diversification enable it to offer customized solutions with superior performance and environmental benefits. The company’s commitment to digital transformation and sustainability enhances operational efficiency and product competitiveness, positioning it as a trusted supplier in strategic emerging industries.
